package.name: mission_supervisor_cpp
package.description: Competition mission supervisor — central semantic provider. Loads competition_*.yaml + GraphML at startup; publishes /planning/global_path (mission path, overriding A*), /planning/competition_path (visualization), /planning/competition_markers (RViz), /navigation/flags (region tag), /planning/current_node/region/behavior/speed_limit/mission_progress/ localization_confidence/mission_score_estimate.
